import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for the source CSV files
    source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/test_0.csv"
    source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/test_1.csv"
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_26/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load Source 0: contains city, date, fare, ride_id
    df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, dtype={
        'city': str,
        'date': str,
        'fare': float,
        'ride_id': int
    })

    # Load Source 1: contains city, driver_count, type
    df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, dtype={
        'city': str,
        'driver_count': int,
        'type': str
    })

    # Merge the two sources on 'city'
    # This is an inner join to keep only cities present in both sources
    df_merged = pd.merge(df0, df1, on='city', how='inner')

    # Reorder columns to match target schema:
    # ['city': string, 'driver_count': integer, 'type': string, 'date': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': integer]
    df_target = df_merged[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']]

    # Save the transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
    df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
